c74object.name: mc.ear.objects~
c74object.category: spatial audio, ADM, panning, audio, mc
c74object.digest: Render ADM audio objects to loudspeaker signals with libear (ITU-R BS.2127), with multichannel signal input and output
c74object.description: Render ADM audio objects to loudspeaker signals with libear (ITU-R BS.2127), with multichannel signal input and output. Every channel of the input is an object with its own metadata; the output has one channel per loudspeaker of the BS.2051 layout given as argument. Metadata is set for all objects with plain messages such as 'diffuse 0.5', for one object with 'setvalue N parameter values...', or spread over the objects with 'applyvalues parameter v1 v2 ...'.

method.name: anything
method.digest: Any object parameter sent as a message, such as 'azimuth 30', 'diffuse 0.5' or 'zone clear', is applied to all objects
method.description: Any object parameter sent as a message, such as 'azimuth 30', 'diffuse 0.5' or 'zone clear', is applied to all objects.

method.name: applyvalues
method.digest: Spread values over the objects: 'applyvalues parameter v1 v2 v3 ...' sets the parameter of object 1 to v1, object 2 to v2 and so on
method.description: Spread values over the objects: 'applyvalues parameter v1 v2 v3 ...' sets the parameter of object 1 to v1, object 2 to v2 and so on.

method.name: channels
method.digest: Post the channel names of the layout to the Max console
method.description: Post the channel names of the layout to the Max console.

method.name: chans
method.description: Set the chans attribute. Maximum number of objects (input channels). Input channels beyond this are ignored. Takes effect when the audio is restarted.

method.name: decorrelate
method.description: Set the decorrelate attribute. Pass the diffuse bus through the BS.2127 decorrelation filters and delay-compensate the direct bus (adds 255 samples of latency). The filters run once per loudspeaker, shared by all objects.

method.name: layout
method.description: Set the layout attribute. ITU-R BS.2051 loudspeaker layout name, fixed at creation (give it as argument).

method.name: list
method.digest: Set the position of all objects: azimuth elevation and optional distance (polar) or x y z (cartesian)
method.description: Set the position of all objects: azimuth elevation and optional distance (polar) or x y z (cartesian).

method.name: ramp
method.description: Set the ramp attribute. Gain interpolation time in milliseconds when metadata changes.

method.name: setvalue
method.digest: Set a parameter of one object: 'setvalue N parameter values...' (N is 1-based; 0 sets all objects)
method.description: Set a parameter of one object: 'setvalue N parameter values...' (N is 1-based; 0 sets all objects). Parameters: azimuth elevation distance x y z cartesian width height depth gain diffuse channellock channellock_distance divergence divergence_range screenref screenedgelock_h screenedgelock_v position zone, and ramp (the interpolation time in milliseconds of the next changes of that object; negative returns to the ramp attribute).

attribute.name: chans
attribute.description: Maximum number of objects (input channels). Input channels beyond this are ignored. Takes effect when the audio is restarted. Default: 16.

attribute.name: decorrelate
attribute.digest: Pass the diffuse bus through the BS.2127 decorrelation filters and delay-compensate the direct bus (adds 255 samples of latency)
attribute.description: Pass the diffuse bus through the BS.2127 decorrelation filters and delay-compensate the direct bus (adds 255 samples of latency). The filters run once per loudspeaker, shared by all objects. Default: 1.

attribute.name: layout
attribute.digest: ITU-R BS.2051 loudspeaker layout name, fixed at creation (give it as argument)
attribute.description: ITU-R BS.2051 loudspeaker layout name, fixed at creation (give it as argument).

attribute.name: ramp
attribute.digest: Gain interpolation time in milliseconds when metadata changes
attribute.description: Gain interpolation time in milliseconds when metadata changes. Default: 10.
